derivation: from an unused root meaning to intwine;
def: a netting (ornament to the capital of a column)

occurrences.text: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
